_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: UPI & payment failures
categories.description: Payments fail or stay pending while money is debited; receiver not credited.

categories.name: Fraud, scams & unauthorized debits
categories.description: Money stolen through fraud, phishing, fake calls, OTP or SIM-swap scams.

categories.name: Frozen, blocked or closed accounts
categories.description: Accounts frozen or debit-frozen, liens, sudden closures, holds on funds.

categories.name: KYC, verification & paperwork
categories.description: Repeated KYC, re-verification, document demands, ID checks blocking access.

categories.name: Fees, charges & minimum balance
categories.description: Minimum-balance penalties, overdraft, maintenance, SMS and transaction charges.

categories.name: Debit & credit card problems
categories.description: Cards declined, blocked, not delivered, limits, chargebacks, card replacement.

categories.name: Transfers, limits & delays
categories.description: Slow or capped transfers, international transfers, NEFT/IMPS/SEPA/wire delays.

categories.name: App & net-banking glitches
categories.description: App crashes, login and OTP failures, server downtime, forced updates.
keywords: \bapp\b|net ?banking|online banking|mobile banking|login|log in|otp not|server (down|error)|technical (issue|error)|not working|\bdown\b|problem today

categories.name: Branch & customer support
categories.description: Unhelpful branches, unreachable helplines, complaints ignored, ombudsman escalations.

categories.name: Savings interest & deposit returns
categories.description: Low savings interest, FD/term-deposit rates, rate cuts.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Salaried account holder
personas.description: Uses a salary account for everyday banking.

personas.name: Small business / merchant
personas.description: Takes payments as a shop or small business.

personas.name: Senior citizen
personas.description: Older customer, often less comfortable with apps.

personas.name: Expat / NRI
personas.description: Banks across countries, sends money home.
